Description: Buy It Now price in listing currency. The fixed price at which a buyer can immediately purchase the item without bidding.
Starting bid price in listing currency. For Fixed Price listings this equals the current price.
Original BIN price before a promotional sale discount was applied. Useful for calculating discount depth.
Reserve price in listing currency — the minimum price the seller will accept (hidden from buyers). 0 if no reserve set.
Currency ID for the listing. Note: not a 1-to-1 mapping with item_site_id; some sites allow multiple currencies.
Exchange rate from listing currency to USD on the listing start date.
Exchange rate from listing currency to USD on the listing end date.
Sales tax percentage charged by the seller for this item.
State or jurisdiction for which the tax_new rate applies.
